title: Org view silently empty when the org enforces SAML SSO
description: Reported 2026-10-18: a view with org:<org> showed no PRs though one existed. Root cause: the gh token isn't authorized for the org's SAML SSO (chainguard-dev, chainguard-images, chainguard-sandbox). GitHub's GraphQL search (used by Ghost) silently returns issueCount 0 with no error; REST search returns 422 'blocked by SAML single sign-on'. Fix: when a search returns nothing, probe REST search/issues once and surface its 422 reason (with a gh auth refresh hint for SAML) as a view warning; the empty view shows the reason, wrapped.
close_reason: REST probe explains empty searches; verified live against chainguard-dev. Branch search-explain.

title: Log errors and actions to a file (ghost.log)
description: From GitHub issue AdamIsrael/ghost#10: the TUI truncates error messages, so the full text can't be read for debugging. Approved design (2026-10-26): log on by default to $XDG_STATE_HOME/ghost/ghost.log (~/.local/state/ghost/ghost.log); log_file in config.toml moves it, log_file = "" turns it off; 5 MB cap with one rotated copy (ghost.log.1). slog text format (control chars escaped). Logs: startup (version, paths), per-view poll errors/warnings when the message changes + recovery, TUI action errors (flashes), every audit event with repo#PR (failures WARN/ERROR, rest INFO). --check prints the path; README Logs section.

title: Retry transient GitHub 5xx search failures before the next poll
description:
From GitHub issue AdamIsrael/ghost#6 (opened 2026-10-15): a transient failure such as 'search: HTTP 502: 502 Bad Gateway' shows in the status bar (e.g. '⚠ Review requested: search: HTTP 502 …') and the view waits a whole poll_interval (default 5m) to recover. Wanted: retry these failures sooner, periodically, instead of waiting for the next poll.

Context: internal/poller/poller.go pollAll → SearchPRs per view; a failed view (err, nil PRs) marks the round failed and Run backs off the WHOLE round (Backoff up to 8×), which actually delays recovery further. github.IsClientError distinguishes 4xx (don't retry) from 5xx/network (retry). Consider: a short in-request retry (e.g. 2 attempts with jittered backoff) for 5xx/timeouts in SearchPRs, and/or re-polling only the failed views after ~30s rather than backing off every view. Keep GitHub secondary rate limits in mind.
close_reason: Retry 5xx/network in SearchPRs; per-view quick re-poll of transient failures. PR #8, closes GitHub #6.

title: Review footer and approval message: separate options, off by default
description:
Posted reviews and approvals currently always carry visible Ghost branding:
- internal/engine/post.go:83 appends '<sub>Automated review by Ghost · agent `X` · commit abc1234</sub>' to every review.
- internal/engine/approve.go:226 posts 'Approved by Ghost: the review found no blocking issues…' plus an agent/commit line as the approval body.
The operator wants neither by default.

Change (decided 2026-10-10): two SEPARATE config options in config.toml, both empty/off by default:
- review_footer: Go template appended to the review body.
- approval_message: Go template used as the approval body.
Vars for both: {{.Agent}}, {{.Model}}, {{.HeadSHA}} (short), {{.Repo}}, {{.Number}}. Validate both at config load like prompts (parse + render with sample data).

Keep regardless of settings: the hidden '<!-- ghost-review-id:N -->' and '<!-- ghost-approval-id:N -->' markers (needed for no-double-post/approve). With approval_message empty, the approval body is just the hidden marker.

Update default_config.toml (commented-out examples), README config table, and tests.
acceptance_criteria: Defaults: review body has no visible footer; approval body has no visible text; both markers still present. Setting review_footer / approval_message posts the rendered custom text, independently. Invalid template in either fails config validation. README + default config document both.
close_reason: review_footer and approval_message added, both off by default; on branch review-footer

title: Audit trail ordering/precision (GitHub #11)
description: GitHub AdamIsrael/ghost#11: user reports the audit trail order looks reversed and blames hh:mm precision. Investigation 2026-10-26: Store.Audit orders by id (insertion order), the detail pane renders oldest-first, and queued is audited under e.mu which claim also holds, so queued<started<failed is guaranteed. Live repro of the exact scenario (r on a PR, claude returns invalid output) shows queued, started, failed in order, matching the issue's own snippet. Local DB doesn't contain the reported run (36e2b4e). Open question to the reporter: what exactly looked reversed. Likely improvement regardless: show seconds (15:04:05) in the audit trail so same-minute events are distinguishable.
notes: On hold 2026-10-26: the reporter is deciding what they meant (1: actual reversal on another machine/version, 2: newest-first, 3: show seconds). Don't start until they answer.

title: staticcheck v0.8.1 fails with local Go 1.27.2
description: Locally (Go 1.27.2), 'go run honnef.co/go/tools/cmd/staticcheck@v0.8.1 ./...' fails before analysis: 'internal error in importing ... export data version 5 is greater than maximum supported version 4'. title: Review label: confirm the label via GetPR before queueing
description: Follow-up from the review-label final review. The spec confirms label REMOVAL via a direct GetPR (search results lag), but trusts a search result that still shows the label, both for queueing a review and for ClearOptOut. If a person removes the label seconds before a poll with a stale search index, Ghost can queue one paid review the person opted out of (the opt-out is recorded on the next poll). Option: in internal/engine gateLabel/enqueue, for label-gated views, confirm with GetPR before queueing a NEW review (one GetPR per review is cheap next to a review). Also consider: first enable of review_label labels already-reviewed PRs and audits 'reviews on the next poll' though no review follows until a new commit — soften that audit text.
close_reason: Direct PR read before queueing/clearing opt-out; view re-validated; check failures audited. Branch label-confirm.
